write_status: reviewed-only; no production insert authorized until image corrections, public-space taxonomy, guarded migration and rollback pass isolated PostgreSQL dry-run
review_method: Confirmed identity, place, opening or completion year, design responsibility and public-space program against municipality, client or design-team sources.
Queried production buildings and target CASE profiles; found zero canonical building or profile conflicts for the five target slugs and CASE IDs.
Queried Commons through the MediaWiki API for author, provenance, dimensions, current license and source URL.
Opened all five current images and three Superkilen alternatives for manual content verification.
Rejected migration of Sumida River Terrace because the CASE describes an evolving multi-district flood-control promenade without a bounded completion year or attributable design author.
Required a public-space function instead of classifying parks and landscape infrastructure as generic mixed-use buildings.

taxonomy_prerequisite.reason: The approved records are primarily parks, promenades or landscape public realms; mixed-use is only a secondary function for Hisaya-odori Park.

excluded.reason: Tokyo Metropolitan Government describes Sumida River Terrace as an evolving flood-control terrace and nearly continuous promenade across seven wards, with ongoing improvements rather than one bounded project. The current record has no completion year or design author. Creating a single canonical building now would invent false authorship and chronology.
excluded.required_resolution: Identify a separately named and bounded terrace section with a responsible design body and completion period, or retain the CASE as a system-level research reference outside canonical building migration.

image_review.visual_evidence: The image accurately shows the Shirahige west-area Sumida River Terrace promenade, embankment and river edge.

identity_evidence: MVRDV records a realised 2016–2020 public-space project in Tainan commissioned by the city government.
